papers.title: Direct conversion of enzymatic hydrolysis lignin to jet fuel via relay catalysis
papers.title_zh: 串联催化将酶解木质素直接转化为航空燃油
papers.abstract: The selective transformation of lignin into valuable products remains challenging due to its structural heterogeneity and tendency to undergo recondensation. Here we report a spatially engineered bifunctional core-shell catalyst, Ni@H-beta, featuring nanodispersed Ni species on the external shell of a zeolite containing Brønsted acid sites within the core. This architecture enables a relay catalytic process involving hydrogenation on the Ni-rich surface followed by acid-catalyzed deoxygenation within the microporous framework. Under optimized conditions, Ni@H-beta achieves complete liquefaction of enzymatic hydrolysis lignin without char formation, yielding 50.1 wt% monomers predominantly composed of jet-fuel-range cycloalkanes. Operando NMR spectroscopy combined with density functional theory reveals a hydrogenation-first pathway that reduces deoxygenation barriers and enhances selectivity. Integrated process simulation, techno-economic analysis and life-cycle assessment further indicate that the EHL-to-jet-fuel process is economically competitive and environmentally advantageous compared with conventional petroleum-derived jet fuel.
papers.abstract_zh: 研究针对木质素结构复杂、易缩合成焦的难题，制备了 Ni@H-beta 核壳金属–酸双功能催化剂。分散 Ni 位点分布于外部、Brønsted 酸位点位于分子筛内部，促进先加氢再脱氧的串联转化。最佳条件下酶解木质素完全液化、不产生焦炭，得到 50.1 wt% 单体，主要为航油范围环烷烃。原位 NMR 和理论计算表明，先加氢能够降低后续脱氧能垒。研究同时进行了过程与经济、环境评价。

abstract_facts.cat_name: Ni@H-beta：H-beta 分子筛内核、Ni 富集外壳的双功能催化剂
abstract_facts.cat_type: 金属–酸双功能核壳催化剂（金属Ni加氢 + 分子筛酸性脱氧）
abstract_facts.cat_active: Ni 9.8 wt%，由 ICP-MS 测定；还原后 Ni⁰ 为主要金属物种
abstract_facts.cat_support: H-beta（BEA 拓扑）分子筛，Brønsted 酸性位点位于内核
abstract_facts.cat_synthesis: 共沉积–沉淀法：2.4 g H-beta 加入含 5.95 g Ni(NO₃)₂·6H₂O、14.9 g 尿素的 300 mL 去离子水；pH 调为2；室温搅拌30 min，90 ℃反应4 h；过滤后110 ℃干燥12 h、空气中450 ℃焙烧4 h，随后H₂气氛500 ℃还原4 h。具体气体流速请查补充材料。
abstract_facts.cat_size: Ni 纳米颗粒约 1–3 nm（HRTEM）；新鲜样品平均粒径 2.6 ± 0.9 nm，第5次循环后 4.7 ± 1.3 nm
abstract_facts.cat_site: Ni 富集外表面负责加氢稳定中间体；H-beta 内部 Brønsted 酸位点进一步脱氧，形成空间分隔的串联催化过程
abstract_facts.cat_cycles: 再生后开展至8次循环；前4次活性保持较好，第5次略下降，第8次未出现进一步明显下降；每次回收后均焙烧和氢还原，不等同于未再生连续运行寿命
abstract_facts.rx_reactor: 100 mL Hastelloy Parr 4566 间歇式搅拌反应釜；实际实验并非连续流反应器
abstract_facts.rx_feed: 酶解木质素 EHL（纤维素乙醇生产的木质素富集残渣），非 HTL 生物原油；采用正戊烷作为溶剂/萃取与传热介质
abstract_facts.rx_catalyst: Fig. 3 基准条件催化剂 0.25 g、EHL 0.5 g、正戊烷 50 mL；优化实验提高催化剂至 0.5 g 时单体碳收率升高
abstract_facts.rx_flow: 间歇式操作，无持续原料流速；搅拌 500 rpm
abstract_facts.rx_temp: Fig. 3 基准条件 320 ℃；温度实验考察 260–320 ℃
abstract_facts.rx_pressure: H₂ 初始充压 3 MPa（Fig. 3 基准条件）；压力筛选 1–4 MPa；注意不是恒压供氢
abstract_facts.rx_mode: 间歇式反应；封釜前氮气置换6次、氢气置换3次；不涉及等离子体功率输入
abstract_facts.rx_time: Fig. 3 条件 6 h；研究了时间效应，作者称约6 h达到该系列最高单体收率
abstract_facts.out_oil: 最佳条件下作者报告单体收率 50.1 wt%，但 Methods Eq.(1)采用 EHL 含碳质量为分母；不能直接写成“原料质量基准的油相收率”
abstract_facts.out_jet: 产物以航油范围环烷烃为主；论文报告最优条件 50.1 wt% 单体收率，但没有单独报出 ASTM 航油规格合格率或 C12–C20 质量占比
abstract_facts.out_hdo: Ni@H-beta 条件下检测油品中未检出酚类化合物；这是检测范围内深度脱氧的证据，不能据此编造数值 HDO=100%
abstract_facts.out_phys: 论文报告液体产物热值约 68.7 MJ/kg，系按 Dulong 公式估算；数值偏高，需要自行核对计算式和单位，不宜直接视作实测 HHV
abstract_facts.out_hydrogen: 气体分析报告 CH₄ 约 29.9 wt%、C₂H₆ 约 2.6 wt%；具体分母与气相产率需结合图表/补充信息再核实
abstract_facts.out_novel: 外层 Ni 纳米颗粒先加氢、内核 H-beta 酸位点后脱氧的空间分隔串联催化；原位 NMR 与 DFT 支持机理

papers.title: Direct production of jet fuel-range bicyclic alkanes from native lignin via a two-step pre-arylation and hydrodeoxygenation strategy
papers.title_zh: 通过预芳基化—加氢脱氧两步法从天然木质素制备航空燃油双环烷烃
papers.abstract: A two-step strategy of pre-arylation and hydrodeoxygenation enables the conversion of native lignin into jet fuel-range bicyclic alkanes.
papers.abstract_zh: 针对木质素基本结构碳数较低且易发生自缩合的问题，提出预芳基化与加氢脱氧组合路线。预芳基化有助于抑制木质素处理过程中的缩合副反应，并将最终产物导向 C12–C15 双环烷烃。以山毛榉木木质素为例，Pd/C 催化 HDO 后双环烷烃收率达到 39.9 wt%。方法进一步用于阔叶木、针叶木及草本木质素，多数情况下收率超过 20 wt%。

papers.title: Surface Coordination Engineered Single-Atom Catalysts toward Biomass Tandem Conversion
papers.title_zh: 表面配位工程构筑单原子催化剂实现生物质串联转化
papers.abstract: Single-atom catalysts (SACs) with explicit active sites have shown advantages in heterogeneous catalytic reactions; however, the optimization of their performance in multistep tandem reactions [e.g., hydrodeoxygenation-isomerization (HIS) reaction in biomass conversion] remains a formidable challenge. Herein, we report a metal–acid bifunctional catalyst that is featured with Ni single atoms immobilized into the montmorillonite (MMT) framework via isomorphous substitution, followed by surface acid modification. The optimized 0.4 wt % Ni/MMT-IA catalyst exhibits prominent catalytic performance toward one-pot HIS reaction of palmitic acid with an iso -alkanes yield of 80.3%, which is preponderant to the state-of-the-art catalysts. Furthermore, the obtained catalyst not only displays durability for 30 reaction cycles (240 h, 300 °C), but also demonstrates universality in HIS reactions of 10 bio-oils. By virtue of in situ spectroscopy characterizations and theoretical calculations, we substantiate a two-step consecutive reaction pathway, including *COOH hydrodeoxygenation and *COH hydroisomerization. The single-atom metal–Brønsted acid site (Ni δ+ -O(H)) serves as the intrinsic active center, which significantly promotes the rate-determining step (β-H scission of the carbonium ion intermediate), resulting in the extraordinarily high yield of iso -alkanes. This work provides a feasible method for the design and preparation of high-performance SACs, which shows prospective applications in biofuel synthesis.
papers.abstract_zh: 研究通过同晶置换将 Ni 单原子固定在蒙脱石骨架中，并实施表面酸性改性，构建金属–酸双功能位点。优化后的 0.4 wt% Ni/MMT-IA 对棕榈酸进行一步加氢脱氧–异构化，支链烷烃收率达 80.3%。催化剂在 300 ℃ 下完成 30 次循环（240 h），并针对 10 种生物油验证适用性。原位表征与计算指出 Niδ+–O(H) 位点有助于促进关键异构化步骤。

papers.title: Revealing Interfacial Hydrogen Spillover in MoO3/Co@CoO for Aviation Biofuel Synthesis
papers.title_zh: 揭示 MoO₃/Co@CoO 界面氢溢流促进航空生物燃油合成
papers.abstract: Abstract Elucidating the role of hydrogen spillover in regulating the active sites of metal-acid catalysts is essential to enable selective lignin hydrodeoxygenation toward aviation biofuels. Herein, we developed a MoO3/Co@CoO catalyst that enables efficient hydrodeoxygenation of lignin and its derivatives into aviation biofuels. The catalyst achieved nearly complete conversion of monomeric phenolic derivatives with ∼99% selectivity toward aviation-range hydrocarbons, while lignin afforded 16.3 wt % liquid hydrocarbons with 53.2% selectivity to aviation-range hydrocarbons under mild conditions. Structural analyses confirmed the formation of a Co@CoO core−shell architecture and Co−O−Mo interfacial bonding. Combined experimental and DFT studies revealed that Co0 sites facilitate H2 dissociation, whereas the Co−O−Mo interface enables accelerated hydrogen spillover from Co to Mo species, generating Brønsted acid sites (Mo−OH) and driving the selective formation of aviation biofuel components. This work offers fundamental insights into rationally controlling hydrogen spillover via interface engineering in metal-acid catalysts for lignin hydrodeoxygenation.
papers.abstract_zh: 研究通过 MoO₃/Co@CoO 催化剂调控金属–氧化物界面氢溢流，以促进木质素及其酚类衍生物加氢脱氧。单体酚类近乎完全转化，航油范围烃选择性约 99%；真实木质素产生 16.3 wt% 液态烃，其中航油范围烃选择性为 53.2%。结构表征证实 Co@CoO 核壳结构及 Co–O–Mo 界面键合，机理研究显示 Co⁰ 负责 H₂ 活化，界面向 Mo 物种传递氢并产生酸性位点。模型物与真实木质素的结果不可混用。

papers.title: Energy-dense sustainable aviation fuel-range hydrocarbons from cyclohexanone as a biomass-derived feedstock via sequential catalytic aldol condensation and hydrodeoxygenation
papers.title_zh: 生物质衍生环己酮经醛醇缩合和加氢脱氧串联制备高能量密度航油范围烃
papers.abstract: • Biomass-derivable cyclohexanone as a feedstock for high-density aviation fuel. • NbOPO 4 catalyst exhibited excellent activity for aldol condensation and alkylation. • Ni/NbOPO 4 catalyst exhibited superior hydrogenation of adducts than Pd/Al 2 O 3. • Similar results from one-pot and two-pot aldol-condensation followed hydrogenation. • Liquid compositions linked to types of coke/char deposits observed on catalyst. Climate change is the main driver for sustainable aviation fuels production as a means of decarbonising/defossilising the sector. In this work, several catalysts have been screened to produce aviation fuel (C 6 -C 16 ) component hydrocarbons from cyclohexanone, a model compound of lignin-derived bio-oils. Using a two-stage two-pot approach, up to 99 % cyclohexanone conversion was achieved in the presence of hydrogen gas. In the first stage, catalytic activities of NbOPO 4 , Al 2 O 3 , SiO 2 , and ZrO 2 -SiO 2 to promote aldol condensation were tested at 160 °C for 3 h. The NbOPO 4 exhibited the highest selectivity towards C-C coupling adducts with mainly C 12 to C 18 . In the second stage, 30 wt% Ni catalysts on three different supports and 5 wt% Pd/Al 2 O 3 were used to catalyse the hydrogenation of the first-stage adducts at 300 °C for 3 h. The 30 wt%Ni/NbOPO 4 was most effective, promoting the formation of bi-cycloalkanes, alkyl aromatic, and partially hydrogenated polyaromatic hydrocarbons. In comparison, a one-pot two-step approach was tested by sequentially reacting cyclohexanone with hydrogen gas over the two temperatures for 3 h each, using 30 wt%Ni/NbOPO 4 as catalyst. Reacting cyclohexanone with 10 wt% bio-oil samples led to significantly reduced first stage conversion, and enhanced yields of single C-C coupled oxygenates and almost no hydrocarbons in the second stage. Overall, combination of catalysts and hydrogen gas over staged reactions has effectively converted pure cyclohexanone into naphthene-rich liquid hydrocarbons and cyclohexanone/bio-oil mixed feedstocks into their oxygenated precursors. These results support potential targeted production of bio-derived sustainable alternative fuels for the defossilisation of aviation industry
papers.abstract_zh: 研究将木质素衍生生物油模型物环己酮用作航油碳骨架构建原料，首先通过醛醇缩合和烷基化延长碳链，再使用加氢脱氧催化剂转化含氧中间体。研究筛选了不同催化剂，指出 NbOPO₄ 在缩合与烷基化步骤具有良好活性，Ni/NbOPO₄ 对加氢步骤的作用优于比较的 Pd/Al₂O₃ 催化剂，并讨论一锅和分步反应及积炭行为。该研究属于模型化合物路线，不能直接视作复杂真实油性能。

papers.title: Mesopore-anchored Ni-based catalyst for efficient hydrodeoxygenation of lignocellulosic oxygenates to aviation fuels
papers.title_zh: 介孔锚定 Ni 催化剂实现木质纤维素含氧化合物高效加氢脱氧制航油
papers.abstract: Abstract Hydrodeoxygenation (HDO) of lignocellulosic derivatives to bio‐aviation fuel remains challenging due to the demand for precise control over metal–acid bifunctionality. Herein, we report a hierarchical Ni/HZSM‐5 catalyst (Ni/HZ5‐0.4‐EG) engineered via ethylene glycol‐assisted impregnation, which achieves spatial confinement of highly dispersed Ni nanoparticles within mesopores. This unique architecture establishes proximity between metallic Ni and acid sites, enabling efficient cascade conversion of biomass derivatives into C 8 C 16 alkanes. The catalyst delivers 73.2% alkane yield with an iso/ n ratio of 3.6, and the product exhibits low freezing point (≤60°C) and favorable density (0.79 g mL −1 ), meeting key specifications for bio‐aviation fuel. Characterizations reveal that the mesoporous confinement and metal‐support interactions synergistically stabilize Ni nanoparticles against sintering and coke formation, endowing the catalyst with robust durability over five consecutive cycles. This work demonstrates a strategy for designing metal–acid catalysts with tailored nanoscale architectures and provides mechanistic insights into active site modulation for complex HDO reactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 研究利用乙二醇辅助浸渍制备层级孔 Ni/HZSM-5 催化剂，使高分散 Ni 纳米颗粒锚定在介孔内，改善金属位点和酸位点的空间邻近性。优化催化剂 Ni/HZ5-0.4-EG 促进木质纤维素含氧衍生物级联转化为 C8–C16 烷烃，烷烃收率达 73.2%，异构与正构烷烃比为 3.6。研究强调孔道扩散和金属–酸双功能协同在生物航油催化剂设计中的作用。

papers.title: Ethanol Upgrading to Jet Fuel Precursors over Ni/MgO@C Catalysts Derived from Bimetallic Metal–Organic Frameworks
papers.title_zh: 双金属 MOF 衍生 Ni/MgO@C 催化剂促进乙醇升级制航空燃油前驱体
papers.abstract: The growing demand for sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) makes extending the carbon chain from ethanol a strategy well worth pursuing. Herein, a series of Ni/MgO@C catalysts derived from Ni/Mg bimetallic metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) was evaluated for the Guerbet coupling of ethanol to higher alcohols within the alcohol-to-jet (ATJ) strategy. Owing to the isolated metal nodes in the periodic framework, highly dispersed Ni species on the magnesium-based solid supports with abundant basic sites have been accessed. The catalyst with a Ni/Mg molar ratio of 0.13 achieved a higher alcohol yield of 55.5% at 88.4% ethanol conversion under 2 MPa N 2 at 240 °C for 10 h. Upon extending the reaction to 24 h, C8–C16+ alcohols accounted for 41.4% of the alcohol product pool. Comprehensive catalyst characterization combined with theoretical calculations revealed that the involvement of Ni species can accelerate the dehydrogenation step, while an appropriate Ni δ+ /Ni 0 ratio can be critical for efficient carbon chain elongation by promoting alcohol dehydrogenation to aldehyde and simultaneously suppressing their deep decomposition through weakened interaction with the catalyst surface.
papers.abstract_zh: 研究以 Ni/Mg 双金属金属有机框架为前驱体制备 Ni/MgO@C 催化剂，用于醇制航油路线中乙醇的 Guerbet 偶联。MOF 框架的金属节点使 Ni 物种在含有丰富碱性位点的 Mg 基载体上高度分散，从而促进乙醇向较高碳数醇的转化。该研究是 ATJ 前驱体合成，不是直接对 HTL 生物原油开展加氢脱氧。
